description: EU counterparty check in one call: screens a person or company name against the official EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List (all aliases, word match, accents ignored) and, with a VAT number, validates it in VIES (valid flag, registered name and address where shared). Returns matched entities with EU reference, programme, regulation and link. A hit is a lead to review, not a legal determination. Price: $0.004 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

name.description: Person or company name to screen, e.g. Al Rashid Trust

vat.description: Optional EU VAT number with country prefix, e.g. IE6388047V, DE129273398
